headline.text: L3 flagged *two* flow-wrap defects in 24 hours — glue misposition on Truffle, silver-outline print on ML4 — both caught before shipment.

summary: Two separate flow-wrap quality issues on L3 lines. Truffle flow-wrap rolls with wrong glue position identified and will be held at end of shift. ML4 discovered defective roll near end with silver lettering outline mid-run; already-packaged chocolate was unwrapped and repackaged. No product shipped.

holds.title: Flow-wrap rolls — wrong glue position
holds.summary: Truffle line identified flow-wrap rolls with glue in wrong position; QA notified, rolls to be placed on hold at end of shift.
holds.status: Hold pending at end of shift.

quality.title: ML4 flow-wrap roll — defective print
quality.summary: One flow-wrap roll found defective near end of roll with silver-colored outline on lettering; packaging does not meet QA standards, roll replaced, already-packaged chocolate unwrapped and repackaged.
quality.status: Resolved — defective roll removed, affected product repackaged.

opportunities.text: Consider adding flow-wrap roll visual inspection to startup checklist — based on today's two separate packaging film defects on Truffle and ML4.
